name: Screenshot Utils
description: Fast screenshots with GNOME Shell capture, delay, naming and follow-up actions. Optionally copies screenshot images to the clipboard; preferences can copy shortcut commands. Shortcuts are off by default. Choose GNOME custom shortcuts or extension-managed keys. Commands require confirmation by default. Turning off 'Ask for every request' lets any local application request screenshots without confirmation; this choice is saved across logins and restarts. Unrestricted local programs can modify saved permissions.
